sql.if: AND ( t1.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') OR t1.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') )
AND t1.medata_set_amd_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'

choose.when: ORDER BY t1.medata_set_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t1.medata_set_logic_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataSetMapper.selectMetadataSetCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataSetMapper.selectMetadataSetList */ t1.medata_set_id , t1.medata_set_nm , t1.medata_set_logic_nm , t1.model_id , t2.model_nm , t2.model_logic_nm , t2.type_model_id , t4.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t4.model_logic_nm AS type_model_logic_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_set_sttus_mtcd_nm , to_char(t1.medata_set_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS medata_set_amd_dt , t5.keywords_ko , t5.keywords_en , t5.category_id , t8.ctgry_nm AS category_nm , t5.agent_id , t6.medata_set_nm AS agent_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.type_model_id = t4.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT a1.medata_set_id , string_agg(CASE WHEN a2.data_type_mtcd = 'keywordsKo' THEN a1.medata_val ELSE NULL END, ',') AS keywords_ko , string_agg(CASE WHEN a2.data_type_mtcd = 'keywordsEn' THEN a1.medata_val ELSE NULL END, ',') AS keywords_en , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.data_type_mtcd = 'categoryId' THEN a1.medata_val ELSE NULL END) AS category_id , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.data_type_mtcd = 'categoryConcept' THEN a1.medata_val ELSE NULL END) AS category_concept , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.type_model_id = 'Agent' THEN a1.medata_val ELSE NULL END) AS agent_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data a1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model a2 ON a1.val_model_id = a2.model_id WHERE ( a2.data_type_mtcd IN ('keywordsKo', 'keywordsEn', 'categoryId', 'categoryConcept') OR a2.type_model_id = 'Agent' ) GROUP BY a1.medata_set_id ) t5 ON t5.medata_set_id = t1.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t6 ON t5.agent_id = t6.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_category t8 ON t5.category_id = t8.ctgry_id OR t5.category_concept = t8.ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataSetMapper.selectMetadataSet */ t1.medata_set_id , t1.medata_set_nm , t1.medata_set_logic_nm , t1.medata_set_desc , t1.model_id , t2.model_nm , t2.model_logic_nm , t2.type_model_id , t4.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t4.model_logic_nm AS type_model_logic_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_set_sttus_mtcd_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_why , t1.medata_set_nwst_rvsn , t1.medata_set_regr_id , t1.medata_set_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.medata_set_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS medata_set_reg_dt , t1.medata_set_amdr_id , t1.medata_set_amdr_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.medata_set_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS medata_set_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.type_model_id = t4.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId}
SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataSetMapper.selectMetadataSetNameById */ t1.medata_set_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId}

/* SQL_ID: MetadataSetMapper.selectMetadataSetDtwListBySubSetId */ WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy_vw AS ( SELECT t2.medata_set_id AS up_set_id , ARRAY [t2.prpty_id::TEXT] AS up_prpty_id_path , ARRAY [t2.medata_set_id::text] AS up_set_id_path , ARRAY [t3.model_id::text] AS up_mode_id_path , 0 AS depth , FALSE AS cycle FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.medata_set_id = t2.medata_val AND t1.medata_set_id != t2.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t3 ON t2.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} UNION ALL SELECT t2.medata_set_id AS up_set_id , ARRAY_APPEND(h.up_prpty_id_path, t2.prpty_id::text) , ARRAY_APPEND(h.up_set_id_path , t2.medata_set_id::text) , ARRAY_APPEND(h.up_mode_id_path , t3.model_id::text) , h.DEPTH + 1 , t1.medata_set_id = ANY(h.up_set_id_path) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.medata_set_id = t2.medata_val AND t1.medata_set_id != t2.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t3 ON t2.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id INNER JOIN hierarchy_vw h ON h.up_set_id = t1.medata_set_id WHERE NOT CYCLE ) SELECT h.up_set_id_path[h.DEPTH + 1] AS dtw_id , n1.medata_set_nm AS dtw_nm , n1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd AS dtw_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS dtw_sttus_mtcd_nm , h.up_set_id_path[1] AS up_set_id , n2.medata_set_nm AS up_set_nm , n4.type_model_id AS up_type_model_id , h.up_prpty_id_path[1] AS up_prpty_id , n3.prpty_nm AS up_prpty_nm , n2.medata_set_sttus_mtcd AS up_set_sttus_mtcd , c2.mtcd_nm AS up_set_sttus_mtcd_nm FROM hierarchy_vw h LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset n1 ON h.up_set_id_path[h.DEPTH + 1] = n1.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON n1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset n2 ON h.up_set_id_path[1] = n2.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c2 ON n2.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c2.mtcd AND c2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property n3 ON h.up_prpty_id_path[1] = n3.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model n4 ON n2.model_id = n4.model_id WHERE h.up_mode_id_path[h.DEPTH + 1] IN ( SELECT model_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_model WHERE type_model_id = 'DigitalTwin' ) ORDER BY n1.medata_set_reg_dt
